purpose: Generic pre-as-of comparator eligibility test for an independent H1 curator.

input_contract.subject_key: opaque token supplied by the receiving curator
input_contract.requested_arena: opaque arena code supplied by the receiving curator
input_contract.as_of: timestamp supplied by the receiving curator

return_UNKNOWN_if: the supplied as_of timestamp is absent
return_PASS_only_if: all six required attributes are present
the first five attributes are PASS

curator_constraints: Evaluate attributes only as they stood before the supplied as_of timestamp.
Do not use later operating performance, market quotations, returns, management hindsight, or later commentary to pass or fail the predicate.
Do not infer a missing operating boundary from ownership, size, or sector label alone.
A PASS establishes comparator eligibility only; it does not select a panel or support any investment conclusion.
